item.title: Perkeep – Personal storage system for life
item.description:
📝 Perkeep lets you permanently keep your stuff, for life. Perkeep is under active development. Things Perkeep believes: Your data is entirely under your control Open Source Paranoid about privacy, everything private by default No SPOF: don't rely on any single party (including yourself) Your data should be alive in 80 years, especially if you are Latest Release The latest release is 0.

item.title: Hard drives on backorder for two years as AI data centers trigger HDD shortage
item.description:
